fusions.name: Charged Strand
fusions.desc: Casts a charged strand that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets. Each hit has a 30% chance of [Exposed] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Severed Thread
fusions.desc: Cuts through one enemy within 7 tiles for 16 damage and draws out every affliction you have on it, dealing 50% more damage for each one drawn. Deals up to 1.5 times as much at maximum range.

fusions.name: Ley Draw
fusions.desc: Restores 3 mana a second for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Stored Charge
fusions.desc: Each time you spend mana, your next spell deals 20% more damage. Once every 8 seconds.
